subject: general
question: If 20 May 2018 was a Sunday, then what was day it on 26 August 2018?
solution:
Given that:-

 
• No of days from 20 May 2018 to 26 August 2018 =11 + 30 + 31 + 26 = **98** as 2018 is a non-leap year.
 
• Since, it was **Sunday** on 20 May 2018, every 7th day from 20 May will be a Sunday.
 
• Thus, no. of odd days = 98/7 = **0**
 
• Now,20 May 2018 (Sunday) + **0** odd days = 26 August 2018 (Sunday)
 
• 26 August 2018 will be a **Sunday**.

Hence, "option 4" is the correct answer.
